research_result.description: Copper is a CRM platform for managing sales and customer data. It provides a RESTful API with JSON responses to access, create, read, update, and delete resources across the platform.
research_result.credential_requirements: API keys are generated in the Copper web app under Settings > Integrations > API Keys by Admin users. Requests require passing the API token and the email address of the generating user in request headers. OAuth 2.0 is also supported for partner integrations.

evidence.claim: Copper offers a RESTful Developer API providing access to most Copper resources.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Copper Developer API ("Dev API") provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to access most Copper resources.

evidence.claim: Copper supports API keys and OAuth 2.0 for API access.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0.

evidence.claim: Only Admin users can generate API keys to perform CRUD operations on Copper data.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: API Keys can be used to create, read, update, and delete data in Copper. Only Admin users are able to generate API Keys.
